biggest_catch: Focuscope's official pages give an average ($100/hour) and an official payment deadline (in-person 3-5 business days; virtual 7-10), but no official numeric payout per project and no official session duration — the required numeric fields cannot be filled.
catches: 'Compensation averages $100/hour' is an average, not a concrete per-project payout.
No official session-duration band is published.
Official deadline is 3-5 business days (in-person) and up to 7-10 business days (virtual) — slower than this lane's bar.
In-person projects require the Chicago area.

c1.evidence: Official participant-resources page confirms a paid program: 'Payment to virtual participants may take up to 7-10 business days after project completion and payment to in-person participants may take up to 3-5 business days.' (focuscope.com/participant-resources/)

c2.evidence: No concrete per-project payout in official terms — only an average rate of $100/hour (focuscope.com/join-our-community/).

c3.evidence: Official deadline is 3-10 business days depending on format, slower than the same-day/days evidence bar.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid.

eligibility: Must join the Scope community and qualify per project; in-person projects require the Chicago area; incentives over $2,000 in a calendar year require a Form 1099
maximize: Treat Focuscope as scheduled-income research, not fast cash — verify each project's stated pay and payment deadline in its invitation before committing, and never frame the $100/hour average as guaranteed pay.
notes: Official pages (focuscope.com) fetched 2026-09-23. Average rate and official deadlines exist, but no per-project numeric payout or session duration is published — the reject rests on those official gaps.

s1.note: Average rate confirmed; no concrete per-project payout.

s2.note: Official deadlines stated plainly: 3-5 / 7-10 business days.

s3.note: Eligibility stated officially: Scope community, qualification, Chicago for in-person.

s4.note: No fee; paid via Tremendous (gift card, bank transfer, PayPal).

s5.note: Flow documented: join, qualify, complete, paid within stated deadline.

s6.note: Per-project pay shown in project listings, not a general official range.

s7.note: By invitation when matched; no volume guaranteed.
